title: A fixed list can match residual accuracy after a quantified budget increase
statement: For f=c+sum b_i X_i+sum_(i<j)a_ij X_i X_j on independent unbiased signs, I_i=b_i^2+sum_j a_ij^2. Query the top L=min(n,ceil(36k/epsilon^2),ceil((16k/epsilon)log(32e/epsilon))) influences,0<epsilon<=1, and return its explicit retained conditional polynomial. Its residual risk<= (1+epsilon) inf_(E distinct reads<=k)R_pi; comparator may randomize/stop and compute arbitrarily. The actual sequential-worker proof retains the nonnegative part in residual derivative energy, preserves SAME-policy revealment under free reveal of T, and combines conditional martingale/Jensen with the tail bound E[1_A g^2]<=2I delta log(2e/delta). Zero risk/unattained infimum and sharper-bound domain are handled at stated scope. No adaptive-policy oracle is used; overhead is a sufficient bound, not a necessary1083k cost or practical win.
